title: Performative Time-Series Forecasting

problem.claim: Feedback loops in real-life time-series forecasting can cause predictive models to trigger actions that alter the distribution of the target variable.

gap.claim: Performativity remains largely unexplored in time-series forecasting from a machine-learning perspective.

narrative_sequence.summary: Time-series forecasting is important across various domains and has progressed substantially.
Feedback loops can make predictive models influence the outcomes they forecast and alter target distributions.
This performativity can produce self-negating or self-fulfilling predictions.
The phenomenon has been studied in classification but remains largely unexplored in machine-learning approaches to time-series forecasting.
